notes: Baseline/subagent runs were omitted because this Paperclip heartbeat explicitly forbids outsourcing or invoking other agents.
Deterministic assertions cover the ADR-backed setup contract, scaffold checker, idempotent repair, git boundary, and source-link safety invariant.

expectations.evidence: Found 3 user prompts before 'GTM context project ready'.
expectations.text: Simple-path transcript contains at most three user prompts before the setup summary.
The scaffold checker passes against the generated repo in a temp GTM_HOME.

expectations.evidence: registry.json has version/project/local active state outside the repo; no local active state keys found in project files.
expectations.text: registry.json matches the ADR 0003 shape and local active state is absent from the org repo.

expectations.evidence: git check-ignore matched 14/14 ignored file families.
expectations.text: The generated .gitignore blocks local state, secrets, temporary files, logs, and ephemeral output families.

expectations.evidence: Initial commit 6638b662 contains: .gitignore, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, business-units/.gitkeep, gtm.yaml, organization.md, people/jordan-lee.md, teams/.gitkeep, workspaces/default/context.md

expectations.evidence: Immediate same-org rerun updated only registry state outside the repo; git status stayed clean.
expectations.text: Re-running setup on the same org is idempotent and leaves the existing repo untouched.

expectations.evidence: Repair preserved protected files and retained the user-defined custom-cache/ ignore rule.

expectations.text: The source-link classifier marks unsafe links as never-commit and committed files/history omit unsafe URLs.
